text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down 3–5% over the past day, with Ethereum underperforming Bitcoin, suggesting mild risk-off sentiment in altcoins despite a stable Fear & Greed reading at 69. Bitcoin dominance holding firm at 58.4% indicates money is rotating into the largest asset rather than fleeing crypto entirely. Volume at $10.4 trillion is healthy, but the lack of directional conviction—Fear & Greed flat over a week—points to consolidation rather than conviction in either direction.
